expertise: Control-plane evidence handoff and semantic governance review

semantic_votes.rationale: Valid contextual rule. In this Skill, the requirement is scoped to deciding whether proven variation warrants an abstraction; the same rule names the evidence an agent must collect and the direct-code or configuration fallback when evidence is absent. It prevents speculative authority and compatibility surfaces rather than imposing an unconditional mechanism.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: extensibility-design owns this decision only when a task proposes an extension point, plugin, policy hook, or shared configuration boundary and claims independently evolving consumers.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Name current consumers, distinct change reasons, ownership, and likely evolution; keep the variation in direct code or configuration and escalate unresolved ownership until that evidence supports a narrow extension contract.

semantic_votes.rationale: Valid contextual rule. The surrounding trust rule distinguishes executable or update boundaries and mutable or consequential activation from config-only or static cases. Requiring inspected evidence and rationale before declaring a listed control inapplicable preserves fail-closed trust, metadata authentication, and rollback behavior; absent evidence, the agent has a clear stop rather than permission to bypass a control.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: extensibility-design owns non-applicability only for a task-local extension control after inspecting artifact type, install or update trust boundary, update metadata channel, activation mutability, and failure consequence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Do not waive origin, authenticity, integrity, authenticated update metadata, or rehearsed last-known-good rollback on assertion alone; retain the applicable control or escalate until inspected evidence supports non-applicability, and re-evaluate when those conditions change.

limitations: This static review establishes semantic disposition for the bound authoring snapshot only; it does not prove runtime enforcement, host behavior, or production safety.
The ballot does not update the disposition configuration or close lifecycle state; aggregation and majority application remain separate.
The declared reviewer identity and expertise are not external proof of credentials or experience.
